name: com.gowarmcrm/mcp
title: GoWarmCRM
description: The sales execution layer for B2B teams. Surfaces prioritized rep actions, pipeline-execution health, and playbook guidance on top of your CRM. Each agent session is authenticated on behalf of a signed-in GoWarmCRM user and scoped to that user's organisation.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the identity of the authenticated GoWarmCRM user behind the current agent session.

tools.name: get_action_queue
tools.description: Returns the authenticated rep's prioritized next actions across deals and prospects.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the rep's prospecting campaigns with status and prospect counts.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Returns a single prospecting campaign with its sequence, prospect stage breakdown and performance.

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: Lists the org's outreach sequences — the multi-step cadences a campaign enrols prospects into.
